text_en: So the order is final?
They're not taking any chances. This unknown plague has the higher-ups on edge.
So many souls will be lost.
No, they'll simply meet their fate sooner, as will all of the misfits this planet harbours.
I understand. That way, they'll kill two birds with one stone.
Questioning something, Liandris?
No, only that...
You've lost a Valkyrie. Nothing like that has ever happened before. They don't want to take any more risks by leaving you here.
What will happen if Yggdrasil is discovered? Planting it was in violation of the agreement.
Once I destroy the tree, there'll be no one left to judge that.
Do what you have to.
Get them away from Terragaya, I'm not going to waste any more time.
Soldier, do not be afraid, come closer.
It seems that fate wanted you to be here at this moment.
Did you see the creature that just left?
At the centre of this world, there is a tree that may be familiar to you.
Yggdrasil. I'm sure that, on your world, you've heard of it or even managed to see it.
Once planted, Yggdrasil supports the very foundations of the world until it dies, causing an explosion so large, it takes the entire planet with it.
That monster's purpose is to accelerate the process by devouring the tree's roots.
If you want to save the lives of your friends and everyone else's, you'll have to stop him before he reaches Yggdrasil's roots.
Not so fast. You cannot enter the depths of this world yet. The heat is too great for you to survive.
Find a way to protect yourself against the high temperatures and I will open the temple door for you myself. The entrance is located west of here.
Hurry, Human! Your time is running out!
